name: Hatahori Misuzu
source:
A girl who boarded the same ship to Hoshimi Island. Speaks with gentle politeness, yet often comes across as airheaded. Highly curious and knowledgeable. Seems to be traveling in search of something.
[Translated from Japanese by DeepSeek]
